summary: The Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) met on July 14, 2011 to discuss BLA 125388 (ADCETRIS/brentuximab vedotin) and voted unanimously in favor of accelerated approval. The Summary Review is the only original (Orig1s000) review document in paperclip and devotes a single sentence to the meeting; it documents a unanimously favorable vote but describes no specific ODAC concern tied to a resulting change to the approval. No supportable concern-to-change linkages could be established from the available review documents, so none are claimed.
